input: selected VGGT raw point-head XYZ; other-camera native predicted Z-depth
rule: keep finite original XYZ with at least min_support OTHER views within relative_z_tolerance; do not move or merge points
unknown: no valid target depth observation, including out-of-view/behind-camera; excluded but reported separately
occlusion: no visibility oracle; depth disagreement may be occlusion or error, never called known incorrect geometry
fit: maximize dev macro F1@2mm; ties first candidate in protocol order; no-op baseline audited but not a tunable candidate

evaluation.alignment: camera-center Sim3 only, fixed across before/after
evaluation.sampling: deterministic evenly spaced original indices; before and after use identical source sample IDs
evaluation.mask: official observation mask for prediction precision; official plane for GT recall; no distance truncation
evaluation.scope: bounded point pilot, not official full DTU leaderboard

runtime.device: CPU vectorized projection and cKDTree; no model inference

unsupported: no compatible dense raw point/depth/camera arrays -> not_supported; no invented dense outputs
